question: Which of the following sectors was given maximum emphasis in the Second Five Year Plan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Industry.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Second Five Year Plan **was launched in India from **1956 to 1961,** with the aim of increasing the pace of **economic growth and development.**
 
• The plan emphasized on the development of **heavy industries, **such as **steel, coal, and machinery, **which were crucial for the growth of the economy.
 
• The plan also focused on the expansion of** infrastructure, **such as** transport, communication, and powe**r, which were necessary for industrialization.
 
• The plan allocated a significant amount of resources for the development of** industrial estates, industrial training, and research and development.**
 
• The plan also aimed at reducing the dependence on **imports and promoting exports, **which required the growth of industries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Community services**:

 
 
• This sector includes** health, education, housing, and social welfare**.
 
• Although the plan recognized the **importance** of community services, it was not given maximum emphasis.
 
 
 
• **Energy:**
 
 
• This sector includes the development of** power, oil, and gas.**
 
• The plan did** allocate resources **for the development of energy, but it was not given maximum emphasis.
 
 
 
• **Agriculture**:
 
 
• This sector includes the development of **agriculture, irrigation, and rural development.**
 
• The plan recognized the importance of agriculture, but it was not given maximum emphasis.
 
 
 
• However, the plan did lay the foundation for the **Green Revolution**, which took place in the **Third Five Year Plan.**
